teaser: Sell to the companies that already have the problem: matching Algarve businesses that built their own AI apps with the region's providers.
core_idea: To match companies adopting AI with service providers, start from the business problem and start when the company has built its own first app: encourage companies to turn spreadsheets into mini apps with a model they own; the apps will break, a crash course in non-functional requirements that primes them; at the handover moment, when the builder has a day job and others need the app, villager companies productise what was built, robust and secure with the model still the editor, selling to people who already have the problem.
